description: Implementation of the CustomerOptionSetDao interface for accessing CustomerOptionSet entities from the database, utilizing QueryDSL and JPA for querying customer options and their associated data within a store context.

classes.name: CustomerOptionSetDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerOptionSet related database operations, extends generic DAO and implements specific retrieval methods.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerOptionSet by its unique ID, including related options and values.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSets associated with a specific option ID within a store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerOptionSets associated with a specific option value ID within a store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all CustomerOptionSets for a given store and language, including nested descriptions.
